title: Cyclic decision tree computes majority
statement: For every seed in $\{0,1,2\}$, the decision tree that queries the three coordinates in the cyclic order determined by that seed computes majority on three signs. It returns the repeated sign when the first two queried signs agree, and otherwise returns the third; this equals $+1$ when the sum of the three signs is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise.
